name: Methods
description: Supernatural Abilities describing what a holy character must do to activate a miraculous effect; combined with a Power to produce it.

name: Powers
description: Supernatural Abilities describing the range of miraculous effects possible with particular Methods; seven are described.

name: Miraculous Effects
description: Limited but reliable supernatural effects produced by holy characters by combining a Method and a Power, rolled against a target level.

name: Tragedy of Hubris
description: Supernatural retribution suffered when a holy effect fails, ranging from minor to ultimate tragedies such as curses, lost abilities, Flaws or wounds.

name: Holy Tradition
description: A group of like-minded holy people organized around favored divine Abilities, through which Methods and Powers are learned.

name: Favored Abilities
description: The few Abilities, usually Methods and Powers, that a holy tradition favors; characters with True Faith may study them without the Supernatural Ability penalty.

name: Holy Connection
description: The holy equivalent of an Arcane Connection, formed through religious ceremonies, prayer, holy authority or consecration.

name: True Faith
description: Major Virtue representing a reciprocated relationship between a person and God, granting a True Faith Score, Faith Points and Magic Resistance equal to Score x 10.

name: Faith Points
description: Points gained from True Faith, sacraments, pilgrimage or holy acts, spent like Confidence or to pray for a miracle.

name: Miracles
description: Signs and actions of God performed directly or through an agent; they have infinite Penetration and cannot be resisted or undone by any other power.

name: Miracle Timeliness
description: Modifier to a miracle's level based on how quickly it manifests, from Immediate (+10) to Generation (-20).

name: Miracle Need
description: Modifier to a miracle's level based on how desperate or deserving the supplicant is, from Calamitous (-15) to Impious (+20).

name: Tests of Faith
description: Trials or ordeals by which God assesses a follower's devotion, often suspending Faith Points or Holy Virtues until fulfilled.

name: Crisis of Faith
description: The loss of True Faith, when God turns His gaze away and the character must remain steadfast to regain it.

name: Saintly Reputation
description: Reputation gained by a saintly character for miracles witnessed; a character with a True Faith Score cannot gain a negative Reputation.

name: Embodying the Light
description: Cumulative powers of divine light gained at True Faith Scores 2, 3 and 5, based on the theological virtues Devotion, Hope and Charity.

name: Devotion
description: Theological virtue (normally called Faith); at True Faith 2 grants Premonitions and the ability to dispel illusions and glamour with a Faith Point.

name: Hope
description: Theological virtue of unshakable confidence in divine providence; at True Faith 3 Faith Points add 6 and Magic Resistance against Mentem is doubled.

name: Charity
description: Theological virtue of complete love of God; at True Faith 5 the character radiates an Empyreal aura.

name: Faith (Virtue)
description: Theological virtue of firm assurance and conviction in things unseen; the acceptance of God.

name: Justice
description: Moral (Cardinal) virtue creating respect toward others, source of piety, gratitude and duty.

name: Fortitude
description: Moral (Cardinal) virtue of willingness to take risks against insurmountable danger, helping resist fear.

name: Temperance
description: Moral (Cardinal) virtue that moderates inappropriate desire; chosen by Arshaq ibn Kareem in the Divine Unity example.

name: Wisdom
description: Moral (Cardinal) virtue of greatness of soul and understanding of truth, guiding prudent judgment.

name: Moral Virtues
description: Also Capital or Cardinal virtues (Justice, Fortitude, Temperance, Wisdom) that moderate fleshly desire.

name: Theological Virtues
description: Faith, Hope and Charity, which infuse celestial traits into the soul directly from the Divine Realm.

name: Islamic Virtues
description: Virtues inspired by the Qur'an such as Righteousness, Generosity, Gratitude, Humility, Mercy and Patience.

name: Divine Warping
description: Warping from Divine sources such as auras, powerful Divine effects and Divine botches, producing visions, stigmata and angelic transfigurations.

name: Divine Ascent
description: Unique form of Warping experienced by holy characters, codified by Dionysus the Areopagite, taking the forms Divine Gloom, Divine Form or Divine Unity.

name: Divine Gloom
description: Form of Divine Ascent in which the character loses knowledge of the mundane while gaining comprehension of the Divine; akin to Hermetic Twilight.

name: Divine Form
description: Form of Divine Ascent transforming the character toward pure holiness, functioning like The Commanding Aura but punishing sin severely.

name: Divine Unity
description: Form of Divine Ascent in which the character personifies a single virtue, affecting others and the Temper of auras.

name: Warping
description: Supernatural change accumulated from auras and powerful effects, measured in Warping Points and Score.

name: Twilight
description: Hermetic Warping experience; Hermetic magi with True Faith experience Twilight, and Divine Gloom is considered its Divine counterpart.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Resistance to supernatural effects, granted by True Faith, Blessing effects, Parma Magica or Divine Form.

name: Divine Might
description: Might score of Divine beings; a dead character with True Faith is invested with Divine Might equal to True Faith Score x 10.

name: Might
description: Score of a supernatural creature's power, targeted by Adjuration and Cursing effects.

name: Dominion
description: The Divine aura, most common source of Warping in Mythic Europe; holy magi may use it for laboratory activities.

name: Divine Aura
description: Aura of the Divine realm, strongest around church altars; can be tempered and causes Divine Warping.

name: Empyreal Aura
description: A Divine aura type radiated by characters with True Faith Score 5 or more.

name: Aura Temper
description: The Personality-trait coloring of a Divine aura, which a Blessing or Divine Unity character can alter.

name: Holy Influence
description: Ability by which a holy character affects people's Personality Traits and the Temper of the aura.

name: Regio
description: Supernatural area of layered levels; Intervention can perceive or create terrestrial or Celestial regiones.

name: Holy Vis
description: Vis extracted by holy magi in the Dominion, with unusual, miraculous side effects and doubled botch dice.

name: Vis
description: Magical resource used to fuel rituals; holy magi may substitute long-term Fatigue for it.

name: Ritual
description: Hermetic spells requiring vis; holy effects instead add +20 level for duration and target limits.

name: Holy Magic
description: Supernatural Ability, analogous to Magic Theory, letting a magus use magic harmoniously with the Divine, invoked by prayer instead of Hermetic words and gestures.

name: Presence (Range)
description: Holy magic Range letting the caster affect targets within an invisible divine aura sized by Presence; equal to Voice.

name: Communion (Range)
description: Holy magic Range affecting things over which the caster has holy authority or a ceremonial bond; equal to Arcane Connection.

name: Recitation (Duration)
description: Holy magic Duration lasting as long as the caster recites scripture or prayer; equal to Concentration.

name: Office (Duration)
description: Holy magic Duration lasting until the next formal prayer hour; equal to Diameter.

name: Devotion (Duration)
description: Holy magic Duration lasting as long as a religious observance continues; equal to Sun.

name: Sabbath (Duration)
description: Holy magic Duration lasting until dawn of the next day of rest; equal to Sun.

name: 40 (Duration)
description: Holy magic Duration of forty days and forty nights; equal to Moon.

name: Fast (Duration)
description: Holy magic Duration lasting as long as the caster fasts; equal to Moon.

name: Grace (Duration)
description: Holy magic Duration lasting while the caster remains without mortal sin; equal to Year.

name: Sin (Target)
description: Holy magic Target affecting an individual stained with mortal sin, demons or unholy objects; equal to Individual.

name: Faith (Target)
description: Holy magic Target affecting only those who worship God, or only those who do not; equal to Group.

name: Dominion (Target)
description: Holy magic Target affecting everything within a divine aura whose source is in range; equal to Boundary.

name: Mortal Sin
description: Grave sin that ends the Grace duration and brings Divine Form punishments such as medium wounds.

name: Schism War
description: Historical conflict whose outbreak ended a Hermetic experiment on the nature of vera fides.

name: Enigma
description: The magical mystery revered by House Criamon; not a proper object of True Faith.

name: The Gift
description: Intrinsic capacity of Hermetic magi to work magic; some theorize True Faith is its Platonic form.

name: Parma Magica
description: Hermetic magical protection; its resistance does not stack with Blessing or True Faith resistance and cannot resist miracles.

name: Hermetic Magic
description: Magic of the Order of Hermes, seen by holy magi as tainted by idolatry.

name: Relics
description: Holy objects with a Faith Score and Faith Points from the piety of the person connected to them.

name: Sacraments
description: Holy rites through which characters may gain Faith Points.

name: Pilgrimage
description: Journey to a holy site that can test faith and grant Faith Points or True Faith.

name: Divine Realm
description: The realm of God, source of True Faith, miracles and holy powers.

name: Infernal Realm
description: Realm of the Devil; infernalists cannot have True Faith.

name: Faerie Realm
description: Realm of faeries, partly aligned with pagan gods; some faeries oppose holy magic.

name: Magic Realm
description: Realm of magic with which magi are associated through their Gift.

name: Invocation
description: Method of calling holy effects by addressing God and His servants by name; usually Communication-based and requires investing Confidence.

name: Meditation
description: Method of entering an ecstatic state through mundane activity to gain insight into God's Will; usually Intelligence-based.

name: Purity
description: Method of creating holy effects through fasting and self-denial; relies on Stamina and costs long-term Fatigue.

name: Adjuration
description: Power to summon, control and banish supernatural creatures and dispel their powers; used with Invocation and Purity.

name: Blessing
description: Power to aid and protect a target by sanctifying it; used with Invocation and Meditation.

name: Cursing
description: Power to bring ruin upon God's enemies; used with Invocation and Purity.

name: Intervention
description: Power working God's will directly on the physical world through visions and transformations; used with Meditation and Purity.

name: Transcendence
description: Power bringing spiritual changes to mind and body, allowing spirit travel and bodily endurance; used with Meditation and Purity.

name: Understanding
description: Power to learn hidden information about the future or God's Will through Meditation.

name: Wonders
description: Power to create and command natural forces and substances through Invocation.

name: Second Sight
description: Supernatural Ability favored by the Ascetics tradition.

name: Holy Music
description: Presence-based variant of Meditation, a performed meditative song, used by Isabelle.

name: Ceremony
description: Supernatural Ability letting groups pray as one for a miracle or include participants in holy rituals.

name: Dominion Lore
description: Arcane Ability teaching about the Divine realm, taught by holy traditions.

name: Finesse
description: Arcane Ability for controlling holy effects; also used to target specific faiths.

name: Penetration
description: Arcane Ability for overcoming resistance with holy effects.

name: Concentration
description: Ability added to True Faith Score when praying for a miracle.

name: Theology
description: Academic Ability used by holy magi to substitute prayer for Hermetic words and gestures.

name: Magic Theory
description: Hermetic Ability to which Holy Magic is analogous.

name: Artes Liberales
description: Ability normally added in ceremonial casting; holy magi use Method and Power instead.

name: Philosophiae
description: Ability normally added in ceremonial casting; holy magi use Method and Power instead.

name: Leadership
description: Ability used by Arshaq ibn Kareem to affect an aura's Temper.

name: Animal Handling
description: Mundane Ability from which Dominia loses experience to Divine Gloom.

name: Swim
description: Mundane Ability that can be lost to Divine Gloom.

name: Charm
description: Mundane Ability that can be lost to Divine Gloom.

name: Profession
description: Mundane Ability that can be lost to Divine Gloom.

name: Hebrew
description: Language Ability required at minimum score 1 for Nephilim Mythic Companions.

name: Spell Mastery
description: Ability reducing botch dice, applied before Divine Form's extra botch dice.

name: Premonitions
description: Minor Virtue gained by a character with True Faith Score 2.

name: Free Expression
description: Virtue whose equivalent can be granted by a Blessing effect.

name: Inspirational
description: Virtue whose equivalent can be granted by a Blessing effect.

name: Common Sense
description: Virtue whose effect Understanding visions can mimic.

name: Subtle Magic
description: Virtue still applying to holy magi casting without words or gestures.

name: Sense Holiness and Unholiness
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue from a Divine source, required of Nephilim.

name: The Commanding Aura
description: Power possessed by kings and ecclesiastics, which Divine Form operates like.

name: Nephilim (Virtue)
description: Free Mythic Companion Virtue marking a character as a Nephilim.

name: Blood of the Nephilim
description: Major Supernatural Virtue required of Nephilim.

name: Greater Immunity: Disease
description: Major Supernatural Virtue required of Nephilim.

name: Great Stamina
description: Minor General Virtue required of Nephilim.

name: Great Strength
description: Minor General Virtue required of Nephilim.

name: Improved Characteristics
description: Minor General Virtue required of Nephilim.

name: Strong Angelic Heritage
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue required of Nephilim.

name: Blood of Heroes
description: Virtue from Houses of Hermes: True Lineages marking a Mythic Companion.

name: Mythic Companion Virtue
description: Free Virtue specifying a Mythic Companion's status; incompatible with The Gift.

name: Lesser Malediction
description: Minor Flaw that may result from a minor tragedy of hubris.

name: Greater Malediction
description: Major Flaw that may result from a major tragedy of hubris.

name: Fear
description: Minor Flaw from tragedies of hubris or Divine Warping (fear of the Divine or Infernal).

name: Poor Memory
description: Minor Flaw that may result from a minor tragedy of hubris.

name: Simple-Minded
description: Minor Flaw that may result from a minor tragedy of hubris.

name: Lycanthrope
description: Major Flaw that may result from a major tragedy of hubris.

name: Blind
description: Major Flaw from a major tragedy of hubris or Divine Warping.

name: Enfeebled
description: Major Flaw from a major tragedy of hubris or Divine Warping.

name: Deaf
description: Common Major Flaw from Divine Warping.

name: Compassionate
description: Common Minor Flaw from Divine Warping.

name: Compulsion
description: Common Minor Flaw from Divine Warping, e.g. prayer or self-flagellation.

name: Continence
description: Common Minor Flaw from Divine Warping.

name: Disfigured
description: Common Minor Flaw from Divine Warping, e.g. stigmata scars.

name: Driven
description: Minor or Major Flaw commonly gained through Divine Warping.

name: Fragile Constitution
description: Common Minor Flaw from Divine Warping.

name: Generous
description: Common Minor Flaw from Divine Warping.

name: Humble
description: Common Minor Flaw from Divine Warping.

name: Lame
description: Common Minor Flaw from Divine Warping.

name: Obsessed
description: Common Minor Flaw from Divine Warping (God, sin, sinners).

name: Pious
description: Minor or Major Flaw commonly gained through Divine Warping.

name: Soft-Hearted
description: Common Minor Flaw from Divine Warping.

name: Susceptibility to Divine Power
description: Common Minor Flaw from Divine Warping.

name: Susceptibility to Infernal Power
description: Common Minor Flaw from Divine Warping.

name: Temperate
description: Common Minor Flaw from Divine Warping.

name: Visions
description: Common Minor Flaw from Divine Warping.

name: My covenant will I not break, nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips
description: Invocation Adjuration effect (Level 20) binding both parties to the terms of a bargain with a supernatural being.

name: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come into his courts
description: Invocation Adjuration effect (Level 50) summoning a supernatural being via a holy connection.

name: The angel of the LORD encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them
description: Purity Adjuration effect (Level 25) making non-divine beings perceive the character surrounded by holiness; demons must flee.

name: The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul
description: Invocation Blessing effect granting Divine Magic Resistance equal to the effect's level.

name: Thou wilt prolong the king's life: and his years as many generations
description: Meditation Blessing effect granting a bonus to aging rolls for a year.

name: My heart is inditing a good matter
description: Invocation Blessing effect (Level 20) granting the Free Expression Virtue for a day.

name: As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him
description: Invocation Cursing effect imposing a penalty on all the target's actions.

name: God shall likewise destroy thee for ever
description: Purity Cursing effect (Level 40) striking the target instantly dead.

name: Let death seize upon them, and let them go down quick into hell
description: Purity Cursing effect (Level 85) laying utter waste to everything within a boundary.

name: Man is like to vanity: his days are as a shadow that passeth away
description: Meditation Intervention effect (Level 20) creating the appearance of a human being.

name: That he should still live for ever, and not see corruption
description: Meditation Intervention effect (Level 25) letting the caster perceive the stain of sin on people.

name: Have mercy upon me, O LORD for I am weak: O LORD, heal me; for my bones are vexed
description: Purity Intervention miracle (Level 50) instantly healing a Heavy Wound.

name: For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device, which they are not able to perform
description: Meditation Transcendence effect making the caster untargetable by weaker supernatural effects.

name: Surely every man walketh in a vain shew
description: Meditation Transcendence effect (Level 30) letting the caster pass through nonliving obstacles.

name: Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep
description: Purity Transcendence effect (Level 50) letting the caster go a year without sleep.

name: Teach me thy way, O LORD, and lead me in a plain path, because of mine enemies
description: Meditation Understanding effect (Level 15) giving a Common Sense-like vision.

name: Thou shalt guide me with thy counsel, and afterward receive me to glory
description: Meditation Understanding effect (Level 20) giving a cryptic holy vision of what to do.

name: I delight to do thy will, O my God; yea, thy law is within my heart
description: Meditation Understanding effect (Level 35) revealing whether an action is God's will and preventing botches while pursuing it.

name: Fire, and hail; snow, and vapour; stormy wind fulfilling his word
description: Invocation Wonders effect (Level 35) summoning and controlling a powerful force of nature.

name: For every beast of the forest is mine, and the cattle upon a thousand hills
description: Invocation Wonders effect (Level 40) creating an obedient mammal.

name: Ascetics
description: Holy tradition favoring Adjuration, Cursing, Purity and Second Sight, practicing ritual purity of mind and body.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The order of Hermetic magi, aware of True Faith and unfavorable toward holy magic.

name: Cult of Mercury
description: Pagan heritage of the Order of Hermes.

name: House Criamon
description: Hermetic House whose founder wrote of the Enigma; St. Nerius was a member.

name: House Guernicus
description: Hermetic House of Moratamis and Samein.

name: The Church
description: Holy institution whose clergy are likely to gain True Faith.

name: Sufi
description: Islamic mystics who revere and seek Divine Ascension.

name: Kabbalists
description: Jewish mystics who revere and seek Divine Ascension.

name: Zoroastrians
description: Faith of Samein Guernicus, a holy magus.

name: Semita Errabunda
description: Covenant of Isabelle, Paul and the maga Moratamis.

name: Mythic Companion
description: Non-Hermetic character comparable in power to a magus, generated with a free status Virtue and up to 21 points of Virtues.

name: Holy Magus
description: Magus who has converted to holy magic, typically regarded as a hedge wizard by the Order.

name: Hedge Wizard
description: Non-Hermetic wizard; holy magi are usually considered such by the Order.

name: Grog
description: Covenant servant character; Paul is one.

name: Zahid
description: Islamic ascetic; Arshaq ibn Kareem is one.

name: Saint
description: Holy person with True Faith who may be canonized and intercede from Heaven with Divine Might.

name: Magus
description: Hermetic wizard with The Gift.

name: Nephilim
description: Divine giants and heroes of ancient myth, playable as Mythic Companions; young Nephilim are about eighty years old.

name: Angel
description: Divine beings who test, watch over and reward holy characters.

name: Demon
description: Infernal beings that flee holiness and tempt holy characters.

name: Faerie
description: Beings of Faerie, some opposed to holy magic and some interested in salvation.

name: Yofiel
description: The Prince of the Torah, an angel summoned after forty days of fasting in the Ma'aseh Merkavah.

name: Dafydd
description: Faerie prince who carried Isabelle through the air.

name: Isabelle
description: Beautiful companion of Semita Errabunda who uses Holy Music and Blessing and has True Faith 1.

name: Paul
description: Grog of Semita Errabunda healed by Isabelle's Blessing.

name: Moratamis of Guernicus
description: Maga at Semita Errabunda who witnesses Samein's miracle of Wonders.

name: Samein Guernicus
description: Zoroastrian holy magus of House Guernicus who destroyed an evil spirit at Tribunal.

name: Jesus
description: Cursed the fig tree in Matthew 21.

name: St. Patrick
description: Preached in Ireland and was shown the pit of Purgatory by God.

name: Jacobus de Voragine
description: Author of The Golden Legend.

name: Hasan of Basra
description: Mystic who prayed on water in a story with Rabi'a.

name: Rabi'a al-'Adawiyya
description: Holy woman who flew on her prayer rug to teach Hasan humility.

name: Farid al-Din 'Attar
description: Author of Stories of Holy Men (d. c. 1230).

name: Muhammad al-Basri
description: Shaykh who miraculously found a woman's dowry certificate.

name: Usama ibn Munqidh
description: Author of The Book of Learning by Example (d. 1188).

name: Plato
description: Pagan philosopher who may have had True Faith; source of many virtues.

name: Aristotle
description: Pagan philosopher who may have had True Faith; source of many virtues.

name: Apollonius
description: Pagan who may have had True Faith in a single Creator.

name: Plotinus
description: Pagan who may have had True Faith in a single Creator.

name: Criamon
description: Founder of House Criamon, who wrote of the Enigma.

name: St. Guinefort
description: Greyhound canonized as a saint despite lacking True Faith.

name: St. Nerius of Criamon
description: Most famous Hermetic magus to possess True Faith.

name: Francis of Assisi
description: Saintly figure noted as a young exception among saintly characters.

name: Blessed Virgin Mary
description: May have had a True Faith Score of ten.

name: St. Helena
description: Saint, mother of Emperor Constantine the Great.

name: Constantine the Great
description: Emperor, son of St. Helena.

name: St. Edward the Confessor
description: Eleventh-century king of England who became a saint.

name: Nur al-Din
description: Twelfth-century ruler of Damascus counted among saintly rulers.

name: St. Symeon
description: Saint whose site of martyrdom is a possible pilgrimage goal.

name: Moses
description: Came down from Mount Sinai with a radiant face.

name: Dionysus the Areopagite
description: Fourth-century Platonist Christian mystic who codified the Divine Ascent.

name: Sir Dorigen
description: Lord whose realm has a Dominion aura of 3.

name: Dominia the Ascetic
description: Example character with True Faith 1 who experiences Divine Ascent and Divine Gloom.

name: Arshaq ibn Kareem
description: Zahid with Faith Score 1 used as the example for Divine Form and Divine Unity.

name: Abbas the Hunted
description: Example Nephilim described in Heaven and Earth.

name: Saul
description: Biblical king who consulted the woman of Endor.

name: Woman of Endor
description: Woman with a familiar spirit consulted by Saul.

name: God
description: The Divine, source of True Faith, miracles and holy powers.

name: The Devil
description: Infernal adversary; there is no True Faith in the Devil.

name: Isis
description: Pagan goddess in whom True Faith is not possible.

name: Jove
description: Pagan god in whom True Faith is not possible.

name: Lugh
description: Pagan god in whom True Faith is not possible.

name: Ma'aseh Merkavah
description: Text excerpted describing the adjuration of Yofiel.

name: The Golden Legend
description: Work by Jacobus de Voragine quoted on St. Patrick's Purgatory.

name: Stories of Holy Men
description: Work by Farid al-Din 'Attar quoted about Rabi'a.

name: The Book of Learning by Example
description: Work by Usama ibn Munqidh quoted in Understanding.

name: Seventh Ring of Solomon
description: Power reducing botch dice, applied before Divine Form's botch dice.

name: Tablets of the Testimony
description: Tablets Moses carried down from Mount Sinai.

name: Purgatory
description: Afterlife realm; Intervention can open a temporary entrance, and St. Patrick was shown a pit leading there.

name: Heaven
description: Kingdom where those with True Faith are taken after death.

name: Hell
description: Infernal afterlife, home of fallen saints' company.

name: Mythic Europe
description: The setting of Ars Magica.

name: Ireland
description: Where St. Patrick preached.

name: Mecca
description: Holy pilgrimage site for Muslims.

name: Jerusalem
description: Holy pilgrimage site for Christians and Jews.

name: Damascus
description: Ruled by Nur al-Din in the twelfth century.

name: England
description: Kingdom of St. Edward the Confessor.

name: Mount Sinai
description: Where Moses spoke with the Lord.

name: Endor
description: Home of the woman with a familiar spirit.

name: Lystra
description: City visited by the apostles in Acts 14.

name: Iconium
description: City visited by the apostles in Acts 14.

name: Antioch
description: City visited by the apostles in Acts 14.
